newsitem.title: PERU: Peru government modifies telephone charge rates.
newsitem.headline: Peru government modifies telephone charge rates.

text.p: The Peruvian government's telecommunications regulatory body OSIPTEL announced Thursday a new scheme of telephone charges with effect from March.
Monthly minimal rental rates rose 10.26 to 27.8 soles, while the commercial rate was raised 3.10 percent to 40.94 soles.
Local call charges rose 1.10 percent to 0.184 sol per minute, while long-distance national calls fell 0.32 percent to 0.616 sol per minute and international calls dropped 2.01 percent to 3.75 soles.
Commercial installation charges fell 6.81 percent to 1,373 soles, while the residential installation rate dropped three percent to 879.47 soles.
Telefonica del Peru, controlled by Telefonica de Espana, has a monopoly on Peru's telephone services until 1999.
